notes:
Snapshot: mid-market UX tool company. Evaluating Redwood Hosted as drop-in replacement for current LLM provider with path to Dedicated once steady-state. Wants minimal app changes -> proposed approach is a lightweight compat shim that translates existing provider API calls to Redwood SDK/endpoints. POC scope: 2-week hosted API POC, integration via compat shim, run prompt parity suite + latency/cost benchmarks.

POC details and acceptance criteria:
- Workloads: chat assistant (real-time), summarization (batch + streaming), doc search embeddings.
- Latency targets: 95th <= 450ms for chat in US regions; throughput: ~3 requests/sec/user avg across 1200 MAU.
- Cost sensitivity: cost per 1M tokens must be <= current vendor * 1.15 for hosted; Dedicated expected to reduce unit cost by 25-40% at 100k+ monthly tokens.
- Quality gate: prompt parity check across 1,200 prompts; regression tolerance <= 5% by automated rank/ROUGE+human spot-check.

Early findings (from hosted POC alpha runs):
- Integration: compat shim approach works, minimal code changes; SDK+helpers from Redwood speed up instrumentation.
- Latency: hosted endpoints measured ~30% faster at median compared to current provider for 1K token chat, 95th still within target for US.
- Cost: hosted per-token estimate slightly higher than current provider (on low volume), but Redwood Optimize suggestions (batching + prefix caching) projected to shift economics in 2-4 weeks.
- Regressions: summarization bundle shows increased extraction hallucinations on ~12% of samples vs baseline; issues traced to model variant differences and tokenization (model A vs vendor-provided tuned model). SE recommended model variant swap and prompt templating changes; also proposed retrain/eval plan.

Security & compliance notes:
- Sparkline requires SSO (Okta SAML) + audit logging and EU data residency for enterprise customers. Redwood initial answers acceptable; ISV legal to run security review with SOC2 report attached (drive link above).

Commercials and migration path discussed:
- Start with Hosted for quick cutover (minimize customer impact) -> after 2-3 months of stable traffic, move to Dedicated reserved capacity. Redwood provided 3 Dedicated tiers and an example migration runbook (drive link). Key ask from Sparkline finance: clear cost delta between Hosted (pay-as-you-go) and Dedicated committed monthly.

Quotes from stakeholders:
- "We need near-zero app-level changes — compatibility is the dealmaker." — Head of Platform (M. Chen).
- "If summarization gets worse customers will notice instantly; that regression must be fixed in POC." — Product Manager (S. Iyer).

- Schedule Okta SSO deep-dive with Security (target 2026-03-15).
